column1: # Svelte template fixture. Hand-written ground truth, written before DevMap ran on the
# fixture; read by devmap-analyze/tests/accuracy_fixtures.rs (same columns as ../ts/edges.tsv).
# Columns (tab separated): id, construct, caller, callee, kind, level, ledger, note.
# A template expression's caller is the component file itself (a bare path).
# Board.svelte is shaped like a real board component: two top-level {#snippet} blocks
# straight after the script, then a run of 300 ordinary template expressions. The
# snippets are the first template bytes, so they are the first thing a cap on how many
# template expressions one file may parse takes away.
